race.comment: BRIGINSHAW (3) hasn't done much wrong with a win and three placings from four career outings to date with hoop Fry being in the saddle for three of those efforts. Is one from one over this distance range and looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside. Should prove very hard to toss. BANG STICK (2) strips fitter second-up from the spell and will appreciate the step-up in journey here. Looms as the main danger. MINNIE VEGAS (8) is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and is usually thereabouts. In the mix. WORTHY GEM (6) returns and has shown enough in his four starts to suggest he can play a major role too.
